win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 19. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - ON THE HOUSE
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the mechanics of the DECK OF FORTUNE bonus, with at least one Power Wheel guaranteed on every reel on every spin!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins 

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

specials.name: POWER WHEELS
specials.behavior:
When a Power Wheel lands, it will stay inactive until all payline wins have been handled. When the Power Wheel is active, the Wheel will start spinning, awarding one of the following possible Cash Prizes: 10x, 100x, 1 000x or MAX WIN. Cash Prizes are paid as a multiple of your bet.

 If more than one Power Wheel lands on the grid at the same time, the values on the Wheels will be added together. The total sum of the amount on the Wheels will then be multiplied with the current bet, resulting in the definitive win.

 When five Power Wheels land in a line on the same row, the possible Cash Prize value on each Wheel will be higher. The possible values are: 100x, 1 000x or MAX WIN.

 If a Power Wheel reveals MAX WIN, the max win will immediately be awarded and the round will end.

modes.name: HIGH-ROLLER FEATURESPINS™
modes.effects:
During the HIGH-ROLLER FEATURESPINS™, only Power Arrow symbols can land. The Power Arrows will land gradually on the five reels, with the possibility of claiming the max win.

 The Power Arrows will land in the following order:

 Five Power Arrows will land on reel 1 
 Four Power Arrows will land on reel 2 
 Three Power Arrows will land on reel 3 
 Two Power Arrows will land on reel 4 
 One Power Arrow will land on reel 5 

 When five Power Arrows land in a line on the same row, the max win of 10 000 times your bet will be awarded as a Cash Prize. If the row is broken by an empty space, that row of Power Arrows will become dead.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - DECK OF FORTUNE
modes.trigger: landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the base game, increasing the chances of landing Power Wheels!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins

modes.name: BONUS GAME - WHOPPING WHEELS
modes.trigger: landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 3 refilling lives by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 At the start of this bonus, you will get 3 refilling lives that represent 3 free spins. When a Power Wheel lands on the grid, the lives will be refilled and new free spins are awarded.

 When a Power Wheel lands on the grid, it becomes Sticky and remains inactive on that position until the end of the bonus. After the final life has been used, all Power Wheels that are currently on the grid will activate and award their combined Cash Prizes. Regular wins will be awarded after every free spin.

 If there is a full grid of Power Wheels, the bonus will end immediately when the Wheels activate and award their combined Cash Prizes.
